00.name: Sour
00.text: Good ridance. Lord Pasta will be thrilled to know we retired his oldest enemy.

01.name: Sour
01.text: I don't see what you were so worried about Sour. We lost the game as I said we would, but we beat lord Burger as I said we would.

02.name: Sweat
02.text: I guess you were right. And I don't like saying that.

03.name: Sour
03.text: And you lumberer why did you side with Sweat. After all you've sided with me every other time.

04.name: Sour
04.text: And you lumberer why did you side with Sweat. I know you've never fought anyone before but after getting lost twice together you should know that we can take on anything.

05.name: Sour
05.text: And you lumberer why did you side with Sweat. After we already fought the tree and got lost together you should have known that we are unstoppable.

06.name: Sour
06.text: And you lumberer why did you side with Sweat. After we got lost and fought the tree together you should have known that we are unstoppable.

07.name: Sour
07.text: And you lumberer why did you side with Sweat. After we already fought the tree you should have had more confidence in yourself and your fighting abilities.

08.name: Sour
08.text: And you lumberer, you sided with Sweat. But after getting lost together you should know that we can take on any challenge that get's thrown at us.

09.name: Sour
09.text: And you lumberer, you sided with Sweat. But after getting lost together you should know that we can take on any challenge that get's thrown at us.

10.name: Sour
10.text: And you lumberer, you sided with Sweat yet again. Why?

12.name: Sour
12.text: Fair enough, so do I. But I love fighting more.

fought_0.name: Sweat
fought_0.text: I can't believe you and the mortal endangered our lives like that.

fought_2.name: Sweat
fought_2.text: We had a chance to resolve this peacefully and without harm coming to any of us. We should have taken it.

fought_3.name: Sour
fought_3.text: I'm sorry we didn't play along with your stupid game that we would have lost anyway.

fought_5.name: Sour
fought_5.text: Of course we were going to lose. The odds were stacked against us so we would have fought anyway. Me and the lumberer just saved us the embarrassment of losing.

choices_0.name: Sweat
choices_0.text: I expected this sort of attidude from Sour but not you mortal. Especially after you were willing to give up your axe to avoid fighting and follow my directions on both forks in the trail.

choices_1.name: Sweat
choices_1.text: You followed my advice for both forks in the trail mortal. Why not follow it again now?

choices_2.name: Sweat
choices_2.text: You followed my advice on dropping your axe and for the fork in the trail mortal. Why not follow it again now?

choices_3.name: Sweat
choices_3.text: You followed my advice for the fork on the trail and dropping your axe mortal. Why not follow it again now?

choices_4.name: Sweat
choices_4.text: I expected this sort of attidude from Sour but not you mortal. Especially after you were willing to give up your axe to avoid fighting.

choices_5.name: Sweat
choices_5.text: You followed my advice for the fork on the trail mortal. Why not follow it again now?

choices_6.name: Sweat
choices_6.text: You followed my advice for the fork on the trail mortal. Why not follow it again now?

fought_6.name: Sweat
fought_6.text: Why is it the mortal never listens to me?

fought_7.name: Sour
fought_7.text: Don't bother listening to Sweaty lumberer. You made the right choice.

riddle_0.name: Sweat
riddle_0.text: Who hoo. I told you it was a great idea. Brain always beats brawn.

riddle_1.name: Sour
riddle_1.text: We got lucky. I still think we should have fought lord Burger. It was three against one and beating him would have been a great triumph for lord Pasta.

riddle_2.name: Sweat
riddle_2.text: Delivering the relic will be a great triumph for lord Pasta, or have you forgotten that.

sour_choices_0.name: Sour
sour_choices_0.text: I know. I just don't understand why the lumberer chose your side after they followed my directions twice and fought the tree.

sour_choices_1.name: Sour
sour_choices_1.text: I know. I just don't understand why the lumberer chose your side after they followed my directions twice

sour_choices_2.name: Sour
sour_choices_2.text: I know. I just don't understand why the lumberer chose your side after they fought the tree and went left that one time.

sour_choices_3.name: Sour
sour_choices_3.text: I know. I just don't understand why the lumberer chose your side after they went left that one time and fought the tree.

sour_choices_4.name: Sour
sour_choices_4.text: I know. I just don't understand why the lumberer chose your side after they fought the tree.

sour_choices_5.name: Sour
sour_choices_5.text: I know. I just don't understand why the lumberer chose your side after they went left that one time. I thought we bonded.

sour_choices_6.name: Sour
sour_choices_6.text: I know. I just don't understand why the lumberer chose your side after they went left that one time. I thought we bonded over the fact my way was better.

riddle_3.name: Sour
riddle_3.text: I know. I just hate how the lumberer only does what you tell him to do.

riddle_4.name: Sweat
riddle_4.text: You don't have to be upset. The mortal isn't playing favourites. But if they were I would be the favourite.

riddle_5.name: Sour
riddle_5.text: This is why I'm your only friend. Everyone else thinks your a bampot.

trail_0.name: Narrator
trail_0.text: The group finally enters the mountain pass and are now within the domain of lord Pasta. After walking for miles the group comes to yet another fork in the trail.

trail_1.name: Lumberjack
trail_1.text: Oh great. Another split. can you guys try not to argue this time and just pick a direction this time.

trail_2.name: Sour
trail_2.text: Of course we can, we're not children.

trail_3.name: Sweat
trail_3.text: What Sour said. And don't worry because I think we should go left this time.

trail_4.name: Sour
trail_4.text: What no. We should go right.
